title: Choice card: options, Best fit, typed answer

steps.text: I want to buy running shoes under 5000 rupees. Ask me what you need to know first.

steps.expect: AT-035: card collapses as if option 2 was tapped
steps.expectJs: (()=>{const log=document.querySelector('[data-testid="thread-log"]');if(!log)return false;const rows=[...log.querySelectorAll('[data-side][data-gap]')];const me=rows.filter((e)=>e.getAttribute('data-side')==='me').at(-1);if(!me||!/^\s*2\s*$/.test(me.innerText||''))return false;const at=rows.indexOf(me);if(at<1)return false;const previous=rows.slice(0,at).flatMap((r)=>[...r.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="card-choice"]')]).at(-1);if(!previous||previous.getAttribute('data-card-state')!=='answered')return false;const summary=previous.querySelector('[data-copy="external"]');const chosen=previous.getAttribute('aria-label')||'';if(!summary||!/^You chose .+\.?$/i.test(chosen)||!/(?:→|->)\s*\S/.test(summary.innerText||''))return false;const next=rows.slice(at+1).flatMap((r)=>[...r.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="card-choice"]')]).at(-1);return !!next&&next.getAttribute('data-card-state')==='asking'&&next.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="card-choice-option"]').length>=2;})()
